result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible layout and state inconsistencies, especially around horizontal carousels and the bottom navigation overlay.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted in green even though the screen displays the home restaurant discovery page.
issues.suggestion: Set Home as the active navigation item on this screen, or navigate to the Profile page when Profile is selected.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are cut off at the right edge, leaving partial chips and a partially visible restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels have intentional overflow behavior with clear scroll affordance, or adjust spacing so the partial next item looks deliberate.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, hiding its title and details at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
